Looking at our Downtown options, we have a few things available right now:

1BR in Act One Tower 1 at AED 8,000/month, a 3BR in Burj Crown at AED 12,000/month, a 2BR in Grande Downtown at AED 15,000/month, and a 3BR in Imperial Avenue at AED 18,000/month. All prices are all-inclusive, so water, electricity, and internet are covered.

What size are you looking for? Happy to narrow it down.
